questions.question: Who among the following founded the Madarsatul Uloom in Aligarh in 1875?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Sir Syed Ahmad Khan) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about Census of India 2011 are correct?A. Population growth rate was recorded as 17.64% in India.B. Population density was recorded as 382 persons per km2 in India.C. Literacy rate was recorded as 74.04% in India.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (All A, B and C) है।

questions.question: According to PLFS and RBI's KLEMS data, India generated more than ______ employment opportunities from 2017-18 to 2021-22.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (8 crore (80 million)) है।

questions.question: How many Articles cover ‘Right against Exploitation’ under Part III of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Two) है।

questions.question: Which of the following organisations was honoured with the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar in 2024?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Physical Education Foundation of India) है।

questions.question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘The Artful Life of R. Vijay’, which explores the unique collaboration between an American photographer and an Indian artist?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Annapurna Garimella) है।

questions.question: What key difference was introduced in the 2024 criteria for Classical Language status compared to the 2005 revision?
options: Reduction of antiquity requirement to 1000 years
Requirement that the language must have modern speakers
Mandatory government funding for preservation efforts
Inclusion of prose texts, epigraphical and inscriptional evidence
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Inclusion of prose texts, epigraphical and inscriptional evidence) है।

questions.question: Which of the following states has the largest area covered under organic farming, as of financial year 2023-24?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Madhya Pradesh) है।

questions.question: Sudipta Sengupta, a pioneering geologist and mountaineer, is the author of which of the following books?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Breaking Rocks and Barriers) है।

questions.question: Which Amendment Act paved the way for the Government to reconstruct the indirect tax law regime into a unified tax structure through the Goods and Services Act?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (101st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2016) है।

questions.question: According to the research by the State Bank of India, released in February 2024, the poverty rate in the country fell to _______% in 2022-23.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (4.5-5.0) है।

questions.question: Which state’s opposition leader alleged 60% corruption in every department in June 2025?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Karnataka) है।

questions.question: What does the Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) indicate?
options: Percentage of employed persons in the labour force
Percentage of persons employed during the last 7 days
Percentage of unemployed persons in the population
Percentage of persons working or seeking/available for work in the population
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Percentage of persons working or seeking/available for work in the population) है।

questions.question: In Tamil language, which of the following ancient epic was composed?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Silappadikaram) है।

questions.question: Which of the following groups represents types of aromatic amino acids?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Phenylalanine, tyrosine, tryptophan) है।

questions.question: The title of 'Sardar' was given to Vallabhbhai Patel by Mahatma Gandhi after which of the following events of 1928?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Bardoli Satyagraha) है।

questions.question: The Constitution of India provides for which kind of citizenship?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Single Citizenship) है।

questions.question: Which of the following physiographic divisions in India features the Karewa formations?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Northern Mountains) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is a factor that can lead to an increase in the money supply through the process of money creation?
options: A decrease in the discount rate
A decrease in the reserve ratio
An increase in the required reserve amount
An increase in the deposit rate
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (A decrease in the reserve ratio) है।

questions.question: In March 2025, which of the following under the Department of Telecommunications signed an MoU with NABARD for Digital Rural Empowerment of rural areas across the country?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Digital Bharat Nidhi) है।
